description: Did this paid endpoint change its terms since you last looked? Give it a previous challenge as the baseline and it returns every difference: price changes with old and new amounts, offers added or removed, a protocol version change, and a payee_changed flag when a new recipient address appears. Never pays the endpoint. Pay 6000 atomic USDC on Base via exact x402. MCP does not pay; it provides a challenge handoff.

baseline.description: A challenge object from an earlier preflight or decode, used as the comparison point.

body.description: Optional JSON body to send with a POST probe.

method.description: Method to probe with. Defaults to GET.

url.description: HTTPS URL of an x402 endpoint on a reviewed origin. Credentials, ports and fragments are refused.

name: x402_metadata_drift
title: x402 Metadata Drift
